title: Only humans can transition to accepted; agents cannot
context: Alternative approaches: allow agents to accept; require explicit review gate elsewhere; use soft gates.
decision: The accept transition (reviewed → accepted) is human-only. Schematify blocks that transition at the Tauri command boundary if the actor is `agent`. No agent row in the lifecycle audit log can read → accepted.
consequences: Humans always review before acceptance; the gate is enforced at the command boundary, not the UI layer; this is a core invariant per PRD §7; agents can do all other lifecycle work (draft, specify, assign, implement) but cannot finalize acceptance.
